findings.finding: Eleven Nansen sections near12S and two separate Meteor sections near11S. Nansen sampling months are uneven; these are not eleven years or twelve calendar months.
Mooring filtering, subsampling and local shelf-break rotation describe another product; they are not automatically applied to the native Nansen variables.

The published transport reconstruction rearranges sections to reference bathymetry and uses model-assisted extrapolation where observations are incomplete. The15-90km by30-200m box is a transport integration domain, not a pair of observed current edges.
